notes.detailedSummary: For smooth geometrically integral projective genus-zero X and actual ample rational L of degree a>0, establish finite algebraic splitting and actual L_C=O(a). A finite Galois orbit of Gauss points has a fixed type-II tree center. Explicit FS sections realize curvature a delta_y upstairs. Q uniqueness makes the reference invariant; D descends it. A section-norm calculation verifies the norming hypothesis required by N.
notes.text:
This is an unverified mathematical proof relative to the complete supplied caller grants O217, D214, N220, T171, Q222 and C218. These labels are not registered note IDs. No unproved general-curve observation is a premise.

Retain K complete, characteristic and residue characteristic zero, with a nontrivial real-valued non-Archimedean absolute value; X/K smooth geometrically integral projective with H1(X,O)=0; and actual ample rational L, with a=deg L>0. All potentials are actual allpoint fixed-bundle decreasing-FS-net endpoints.

First prove the actual splitting antecedent. Flat field tensor commutes with the cohomology of a finite affine Čech cover. Choose a point P over a finite E0/K. Proper geometric integrality gives H0(X_E0,O)=E0, and H1 remains zero. The sequence 0→O→O(P)→O(P)|P→0 supplies two sections without common zero and a morphism f:X_E0→P1 with exactly one simple pole P. The sequences for (n−1)P and nP give H1(O(nP))=0 and dim H0(O(nP))=n+1. Distinct pole orders show that 1,f,…,f^n form a basis. For any rational q, multiply by sufficiently high powers of polynomials in f vanishing at the residues f(R) of its finitely many poles R other than P. The resulting h(f)q has poles only at P and hence is a polynomial in f. Thus E0(X)=E0(f). The rational inverse extends over each DVR of P1 by properness, extends to neighborhoods by finite presentation, and glues by separatedness. Both compositions are identity. Enlarge E0 to finite Galois E/K. Divisor calculus on P1 identifies the actual pulled-back rational bundle with O(a). Geometric degree stays a, without a field-degree multiplier.

Set C=completed algebraic closure, Y=X_C^an and G=Gal(bar K/K), using the complete D/Q setting. The splitting is defined over E, so its Gauss point y0 is fixed by Gal(bar K/E); coefficient automorphisms preserve Gauss norms. Its G orbit S is finite. The semilinear action is a valued coefficient automorphism followed by a PGL2 transformation: an algebraic automorphism pulls back O(1) and acts on its two-dimensional section space. Translations preserve disk radii, scalings shift logarithmic radii by a common constant, and inversion sends a disk (b,r) avoiding zero to (1/b,r/|b|²), with the corresponding zero/infinity chain interchange. These formulas preserve path length and type II.

The hull H of S is a finite metric tree with type-II leaves and branch vertices. Choose diameter leaves A,B, distance D, and midpoint y. For x attaching to [A,B] at coordinate t with height h, diameter maximality gives h≤min(t,D−t), so d(y,x)≤D/2. A center z with distances at most D/2 to both endpoints must satisfy t+h≤D/2 and D−t+h≤D/2, forcing t=D/2 and h=0. Therefore y is the unique circumcenter and is G-fixed. Edge lengths lie in the logarithmic value group; that group is divisible over C. The midpoint is consequently type II. The singleton case is immediate. No path-metric boundedness is inferred from analytic compactness alone.

Write y=zeta(b,|c|). The independent sections cT0 and T1−bT0 give an actual degree-one FS metric with genuine measure delta_y by Q's complete atom construction. Degree-ma monomials, divided by m, give an actual continuous FS metric phi_y on L_C with genuine measure a delta_y. Each conjugate has the same measure. Both metrics are continuous finite-energy metrics on the same actual bundle, so Q every-solution allpoint uniqueness identifies them modulo a finite constant. Normalize sup(phi_y−psi0_C)=0 relative to any pulled-back continuous reference. Invariance of that reference forces every constant to vanish. D now descends this invariant actual metric to a continuous psh reference psi on L. O pushforward gives MA_psi(0)=a delta_xi, xi=pi(y).

Atomic curvature alone would not prove norming. In coordinates sending y to Gauss, every section of O(d) has norm |sum b_j w^j|/max(1,|w|)^d bounded by max|b_j| in both charts, with equality at Gauss. Thus each weighted FS scalar attains its supremum at y. Pullback of every downstairs FS system is such a system, and D surjectivity gives sup_T v=v(xi). For an actual decreasing FS net v_i→u, the numbers c_i=v_i(xi)=sup v_i decrease. If their limit were negative infinity, u would be identically negative infinity. Otherwise u(xi)=inf c_i=sup u is finite. This establishes the exact additional reference hypothesis of N at every point, including poles.

The complete proof is in P16.4-argument.md and standalone P16.4-paper.tex. Full grants and clarifications are extracted from untouched input.json by python3 extract_grants.py. Rebuild with python3 build_deliverable.py. No analogous actual reference realization is proved here for positive-genus curves or higher-dimensional varieties.

notes.summary: Complete new genus-zero equation sector over every retained complete field, including nonsplit conics: intrinsic target equivalence, actual existence and every-solution allpoint uniqueness. Full arbitrary-dimensional P16.4 remains open.
notes.detailedSummary: For raw target mass a=deg L, prove finite continuous-test dual iff all actual E1 tests are integrable iff the target is a genuine MA output. Verify all upstairs geometry, bundle, target and equation antecedents before applying D descent. T handles trivial valuations. Actual solutions attain the variational maximum. In the norming reference, B(tu)=t²B(u), J(mu)=−E(u), and the unit-energy bound gives explicit square-root coercivity.
notes.text:
Retain X/K smooth geometrically integral projective of genus zero, actual ample rational L with a=deg L>0, and K complete characteristic-zero real-valued non-Archimedean with residue characteristic zero. Trivial, nontrivial, discrete, nondiscrete and non-algebraically-closed fields are included. The local prerequisite is n1; the complete supplied O/D/N/T/Q/C bodies remain mathematical caller grants rather than registered note IDs.

For any continuous actual psh reference psi, continuous curve energy is E(u)=1/2∫u[MA(u)+MA(0)]. Extend it by the infimum of continuous psh majorant energies; E1 consists of actual endpoints with energy greater than negative infinity. The genuine O operator acts on this class with raw mass a, every-E1-test integrability and weighted arbitrary decreasing-net continuity. C supplies strict Borel locality, open locality and comparison.

For a positive Radon target, the exact condition is mu(T)=a and J_psi(mu)=sup over continuous actual psh v of [E(v)−∫v dmu]<infinity. Constants cancel at this raw mass. The theorem proves equivalence with absolute integrability of every actual E1 scalar and with mu=MA(u) for actual u∈E1. Every solution is unique modulo one finite real constant at every analytic point. No support or symmetry restriction is imposed.

For nontrivial valuations, n1 proves the actual norming reference MA(0)=a delta_xi and sup u=u(xi). The complete N theorem therefore applies downstairs and proves the intrinsic converse, rather than merely testing invariant upstairs singular functions. Normalize u(xi)=0 and write B(u)=−E(u), A_mu(u)=∫(−u)dmu, and U_mu=sup{A_mu(u):u normalized actual E1, B(u)≤1}. N gives all-test integrability iff U_mu is finite iff J is finite.

The curve scaling is exact. O gives MA(tu)=(1−t)a delta_xi+t MA(u). The genuine energy identity and u(xi)=0 imply E(tu)=t²E(u), hence B(tu)=t²B(u). At t=0 the reference metric is used, without multiplying a pole by zero. Choosing t=1 or B(u)^(−1/2) gives A_mu(u)≤U_mu max(1,sqrt B(u)). Thus the normalized objective is bounded by −B+U_mu+U_mu sqrt B and J≤U_mu+U_mu²/4. Coercivity alone is not called attainment.

Given finite J and raw mass a, D supplies the unique invariant Radon lift sigma on Y=X_C^an, preserving mass and satisfying J_C(sigma)=J_K(mu). By n1, X_C is actually P1_C and L_C actually O(a). Section pullback identifies FS systems and actual allpoint endpoints; continuous curvature naturality and O's decreasing limits identify the energy and operator. Every Q hypothesis now holds for this actual arbitrary-support upstairs target. Q supplies an actual upstairs E1 solution w and every-solution allpoint uniqueness.

Normalize sup_Y w=0 relative to the invariant pulled-back reference. Semilinear pullback preserves FS endpoints and the genuine operator by continuous naturality and O's limits. Consequently g*w solves the same invariant target. Q uniqueness and normalization give g*w=w. Only after establishing those antecedents does D descend w to an actual downstairs psh u. Apply its extended energy equality before assuming finite energy: E_K(u)=E_C(w)>−infinity. O's finite-energy field pushforward is now applicable and gives MA_K(u)=pi_*sigma=mu. No singular potential is averaged, no abstract Hilbert element is named as a potential, and no target defines MA.

For any two original solutions u,v, O makes their pullbacks finite energy. Their upstairs measures are invariant and both push to mu. D invariant-lift uniqueness identifies both with sigma. Q gives pi*u=pi*v+c at every upstairs point; surjectivity gives u=v+c at every original point. Common poles are retained without subtracting negative infinities. Every output integrates every E1 test by O, so the proved N criterion gives finite dual in the converse direction. For trivial valuations T supplies the actual ample equation and intrinsic criterion in its exact granted domain. Its operator agrees with O continuously and along the same decreasing approximations.

For attainment, O concavity and the genuine affine-segment derivative give E(v)−E(u)≤∫(v−u)MA(u) for every actual E1 competitor. All integrals are finite. Hence every solution maximizes the objective. Continuous majorants decreasing to u converge in energy and in their integrals against the fixed output by O weighted continuity, so the maximum equals the original continuous-test J. In the norming reference, E(u)=1/2∫u dmu, giving J(mu)=−E(u). Reference covariance changes J by the finite quantity −E_psi(b)+∫b dmu for the bounded continuous reference difference b; the absolute equation and intrinsic condition are unchanged.

Normalized compactness and envelope/orthogonality/both-sign outer differentiation are replaced as existence inputs by Q's actual tree construction and the verified geometric/descent antecedents. They are not asserted in general geometry. C comparison is retained, while uniqueness is proved through actual every-solution uniqueness and invariant lifts. Artifacts are P16.4-paper.tex, P16.4-paper.pdf and P16.4-argument.md; rerun python3 build_deliverable.py. This unverified draft proves a complete genus-zero sector relative to the grants, not the entire original P16.4.

notes.detailedSummary: Over the complete Hahn field R((t^Q)), the ordered-field conic X0²+X1²+X2²=0 is nonsplit and its actual O_X(1) has degree 2. Two conjugate disk atoms yield a nonreference target 2 delta_eta with an actual descended continuous solution. Lightweight exact checks cover the parametrization, a specified finite tree, 15 finite target vectors and subdivision arithmetic. Existing tools produce an 11-page PDF.
notes.text:
Using n2, take K=R((t^Q)), the real-coefficient Hahn field with well-ordered rational exponent support and |f|=exp(−min supp f). Completeness follows by summing successive differences of a Cauchy subsequence whose valuations exceed the integer index: below any fixed bound only finitely many difference supports occur, their union is well ordered, and the coefficient sums are locally finite. Its residue field is R and its value group is nondiscrete; both characteristics are zero. Leading-coefficient positivity orders K.

The smooth geometrically integral conic X0²+X1²+X2²=0 therefore has no K-point, since a nonzero sum of squares is positive. It is nonsplit, with actual ample L=O_X(1) of raw degree 2. Over K(i), [s:r]↦[s²−r²:i(s²+r²):2sr] is an isomorphism, with inverse charts [X0−iX1:X2] and [X2:−X0−iX1]. Thus L becomes actual O(2). Galois conjugation acts by coefficient conjugation followed by z↦−1/z, fixing Gauss. Because |2|=|i|=1, max(|s²−r²|,|s²+r²|,|2sr|)=max(|s|,|r|)². The embedding FS reference has genuine measure 2 delta_xi and is norming.

Let y_−=zeta(0,|t|), y_+=zeta(0,|t|^−1). Their Galois orbit is this pair and their image eta differs from xi. The invariant measure delta_y−+delta_y+ pushes to mu=2 delta_eta. Degree-two scaled actual atom metrics have measures 2 delta_y− and 2 delta_y+ on actual O(2), so O/Q give finite intrinsic dual for their half-sum. D preserves that dual downstairs. The actual tensor sum of the two degree-one atom metrics has scalar u=−g(.,y_−)−g(.,y_+) relative to twice the standard reference, and genuine measure delta_y−+delta_y+. Q uniqueness and normalization make it invariant, so it descends. Each self-kernel has length 1 and the cross-kernel is zero. Consequently ∫u dmu=−2, E(u)=−1 and J(mu)=1. The theorem permits arbitrary finite-energy target support beyond this example.

The retained program finite_checks.py returned exit 0. Its specified tree has vertices a,l,o,r,b,c and edges a−l length1, l−o length2, o−r length2, r−b length1, o−c length2. It verifies distance preservation by the reflection exchanging a/b and l/r, and checks all 21 half-unit edge-grid positions: diameter 6, unique grid center o, fixed by reflection. For all 15 denominator-4 probability vectors on three leaves with diagonal root kernel (3,3,2), it checks raw mass 2 and E=−mu^T G mu/2, objective=mu^T G mu/2. It also checks the conic polynomial identity, the two-atom energy bookkeeping and an exact subdivision identity in Q(sqrt2). Exhaustiveness concerns only these specified finite inputs.

notes.text:
This is a diagnostic scope note, not an impossibility theorem. The unchanged original P16.4 concerns arbitrary-dimensional smooth geometrically integral projective X, actual ample rational L, all retained complete fields and arbitrary mass-(L^n) finite-energy Radon targets. Result n2 closes all genus-zero curves, including nonsplit nontrivially valued cases. It does not close positive-genus curves or higher dimensions. The full-domain operator and locality/comparison are supplied grants O and C, not new proofs of those manuscripts.

Still unproved here for general X are normalized actual-potential compactness in a usable topology, general envelope/orthogonality and both-sign outer continuous-direction differentiation where variational existence requires them, a general intrinsic all-E1 target converse or adequate replacement estimate, actual attainment for every target, and every-solution allpoint uniqueness. D's equation transfer remains conditional on actual upstairs antecedents. Completed algebraic closure does not turn a nondiscrete valuation into a discrete one. P16.3, P16.5 and P16.7 remain separate originals.

Fresh primary inspection used https://arxiv.org/pdf/1712.00980v3, Gubler–Jell–Künnemann–Martin, submitted 2018-11-22, with manuscript date 2018-11-26. Entire Section 3, browser lines 462–743, including the complete relevant proposition/theorem proofs and its final discrete-only rationality subsection, was read. The arbitrary nontrivial-field curve model and envelope statements do not automatically realize an arbitrary graph distribution as an actual metric. Semistable refinement, algebraization, model-recognition and slope-formula dependencies were identified but not reconstructed here, so those results are diagnostic only. The complete Theorem 7.8/Corollary 7.9 proof in https://arxiv.org/pdf/1805.01016v3, dated 2021-01-08, was also read. It recognizes actual nef models on actual ample bundles; it cannot supply a missing model merely by naming a graph function.

An independent arithmetic caution is proved: on two parallel fixed edges of lengths 1 and sqrt2, rational slopes for a common endpoint difference d require d and d/sqrt2 rational. Nonzero d would make sqrt2 rational, so d=0. Rational-slope density on fixed irrational cycles cannot simply be assumed. On one edge of length ell with difference d and rational s1<d/ell<s2, a split at t=(d−s2 ell)/(s1−s2) satisfies 0<t<ell, s1t+s2(ell−t)=d and a nonnegative bend. If ell and d lie in a divisible value group, so does t. This calculation proves neither all-vertex positivity, formal frames, actual model recognition nor fixed-bundle FS realization.
